title: P5-07: Create the new CMS app and fresh backend from the template, GitHub App connect, first build, release gates
description:
## Goal
A NEW CMS app (WEB_COMPUTE, newspaper at `/information` and `/newsroom` in one app) created from the template with a fresh backend, connected to `AnthusAI/p.apyr.us` with the Amplify GitHub App, first build green on its default `amplifyapp.com` URL, release gates passed. No custom domain yet. The old app dbsyytcm9drqa keeps serving p.apyr.us untouched.

## Context (FACT)
- Why a new app, not reconnecting dbsyytcm9drqa (this reverses the old plan in docs/standard-site.md 3.1): the old app has real backend data, and the console connect flow was observed on 2026-10-06 (Pilobol.us CMS) to delete the app's branches and their environment variables; for a Gen2 app, deleting the `main` branch can delete its backend stack and with it the data. A fresh app leaves the old one intact as the rollback. Same reasoning as docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md section 2.
- Old app: WEB_COMPUTE, repo https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus (token-based connection), branches `main` (PRODUCTION, last job 336 SUCCEED 2026-10-05) and `codex-rehydration-api-split` (DEVELOPMENT, last job FAILED 2026-05-23), no backend environments listed, service role AmplifySSRLoggingRole-... (no compute role).
- Template needs (docs/site-hosting.md "Verify and repair after connecting"): check platform stays WEB_COMPUTE, service role not replaced, branches and env vars not lost; Python 3.12 provisioning.
- New Cognito domain prefix: `papyrus-p-apyr-us` (must differ from the old pool us-east-1_40Uot7WSv, whose domain is the auto-generated `48215fcaaf4ddb708e9f`).
- Stack name must not collide with an existing `amplify-app-shell-*` stack (use `stackName` in site.json).
- Depends on the TI sub-tasks that fix template gaps shared with this site: PPY-4f2519 (domain/staging host) and PPY-153434 (first-build lessons). Do not repeat them.

## Exact steps
1. Ryan: `aws sso login --profile legacy`; yes to deploying the stack (synth, review `cdk diff`, `cdk deploy`, profile legacy). Record AppId. Flags `inboundEmail`, `slack`, `storageBackups`, `consoleResponder` all false until P5-11 (P5-04).
2. Ryan, one console sitting: install the AWS Amplify GitHub App on `AnthusAI/p.apyr.us`, connect the new app to branch `main` with the template's service role, add the `staging` branch if missing. Compare `get-app` and `list-branches` before and after and apply the documented repairs.
3. Start the first build; wait for backend `pipeline-deploy` and the frontend build.
4. Gate checks: schema gate (`bodyMarkus`, `bodyIr`, `aliases` on Item and PublishedItem), brand gate (`PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND` equal the brand id), probes on the default URL: `/` (marketing), `/information`, `/newsroom`, `/robots.txt`, a missing path returns the 404 page.
5. Record names of env vars only.

## Acceptance checks
- `aws amplify get-app` shows platform WEB_COMPUTE, repository AnthusAI/p.apyr.us, the template role; `list-branches` shows `main` with the NAMES from site.json plus SITE_ENV, PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND, PAPYRUS_CONTENT_SOURCE.
- Job SUCCEED; new AppSync API and Cognito pool exist; the three gates pass; probes return the expected codes.

## Rollback
Delete the new stack (human-run) and redeploy; nothing public depends on it.

## Risks
Console connect side effects (repairs documented); Python 3.12 on the Amplify image unproven; account-global names (S3 Vectors index, SES rule set, backup vault) must not collide with the old backend (P5-04).

## Needs Ryan
SSO login, deploy yes, GitHub App console sitting, repo access.

comments.text: P5-07 build fix (2026-10-09, account 712236451410 only). ROOT CAUSE of the old-form app buildSpec: not a template/version problem. The live CFN template of amplify-app-shell-p-apyr-us-cms already contains the correct spec (env passthrough before build, cp amplify_outputs.json after; identical to papyrus-infra print-buildspec for next.31, frontend pretext). CloudTrail: the console Connect-repository flow (user ryan, UpdateApp 11:21:25 EDT, buildSpec param plus repository, DeleteBranch main 11:18:42, CreateBranch main 11:21:25) overwrote the App buildSpec with the console-detected default; CFN does not revert out-of-band drift because the template value never changed. Add to the console-connect side effects list in docs. FIX: aws amplify update-app --build-spec with the exact template spec (2026-10-09 17:33:23Z); no stack update was needed or possible (cdk template diff vs live: only OAUTH redirect list, live is a superset of the domain-free copy, so do NOT redeploy from the copy). Verified: WEB_COMPUTE, repository https://github.com/anthusai/p.apyr.us, roles intact, branch main PRODUCTION autoBuild with 12 env names (PAPYRUS_APPLY_COGNITO_DOMAIN_PREFIX, PAPYRUS_COGNITO_DOMAIN_PREFIX, PAPYRUS_CONTENT_SOURCE, PAPYRUS_EDITION_SLUG, PAPYRUS_ENABLE_CONSOLE_RESPONDER, PAPYRUS_ENABLE_INBOUND_EMAIL, PAPYRUS_ENABLE_SLACK, PAPYRUS_ENABLE_STORAGE_BACKUPS, PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS, PAPYRUS_REVALIDATE_SECRET_PARAMETER, PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND, SITE_ENV). Job 4 SUCCEED (BUILD, DEPLOY, VERIFY), no AppSync throttling. HTTP on default URL: / 200, /newsroom 200, /2026/october/07 308 -> /information/2026/october/07, /robots.txt 404, missing path 404, old p.apyr.us 200. /information STILL 500 but with a new cause: the amplify_outputs error is gone; now ENOENT open /tmp/app/corpora/papyrus-newsroom-sections.yml (from .next/server/app/information/page.js): repo corpora/*.yml are not in the compute bundle (no outputFileTracingIncludes in the scaffold next.config.mjs or withPapyrus next.31). Needs a template or scaffold fix; not done. Cognito domain/callbacks unchanged. Ticket not closed.
